entries.en: The pond bald cypress stood behind a row of newly painted benches.
entries.zh: 那棵池柏立在一排新刷过漆的长凳后面。

entries.en: We shifted the picnic table away from the damaged pond cypress.
entries.zh: 我们把野餐桌从那棵受损的池柏旁移开了。

entries.en: The photographer framed the pond pine against the pale evening sky.
entries.zh: 摄影师以傍晚浅淡的天空为背景拍摄了那棵晚果松。

entries.en: A wooden sign hung from the ponderosa pine beside the cabin.
entries.zh: 小屋旁那棵西黄松上挂着一块木牌。

entries.en: The porcupine fish swam behind a rock before the visitor raised her camera.
entries.zh: 游客还没举起相机，那条刺魨就游到了石头后面。

entries.en: The naturalist photographed the pore fungus without removing it from the log.
entries.zh: 博物学者拍下了那株多孔菌，没有把它从圆木上取下来。

entries.en: The sculptor rejected the porphyritic rock because of a deep crack.
entries.zh: 雕刻家因为一道深裂纹而弃用了那块斑岩。

entries.en: The caretaker set two empty pots beneath the portia tree.
entries.zh: 管理员把两个空花盆放在了那棵桐棉下。

entries.en: The possum haw had grown across the narrow entrance to the garden.
entries.zh: 那株落叶冬青已长得挡住了花园狭窄的入口。

entries.en: The exhausted messenger exchanged his post horse at the next inn.
entries.zh: 筋疲力尽的信使在下一个旅店换了驿马。

entries.en: The survey crew measured the distance between the post oak and the road.
entries.zh: 测量队量了那棵柱杆栎到公路的距离。

entries.en: We cut the poster board into arrows for the school fair.
entries.zh: 我们把招贴用纸板剪成箭头，用于学校义卖会。

entries.en: The pot marigold on the windowsill leaned toward the morning light.
entries.zh: 窗台上的金盏花朝着晨光倾斜。

entries.meaningZh: 铜铅合金〔旧时制大容器用〕
entries.en: The foundry poured the pot metal into a mold for a large vessel.
entries.zh: 铸造厂把铜铅合金浇进了一个大容器的铸模里。

entries.en: The technician weighed the potassium muriate before preparing the test mixture.
entries.zh: 技术员在配制试验混合物前称量了氯化钾。

entries.en: A potato bug clung to the underside of the leaf I turned over.
entries.zh: 我翻开叶子时，一只薯虫紧附在叶片背面。

entries.en: The gardener placed plants from the potato family in a separate bed.
entries.zh: 园丁把茄科植物种在了单独的一块畦里。

entries.en: The potato moth escaped through a gap in the net.
entries.zh: 那只马铃薯块茎蛾从网的一个缝隙中逃走了。

entries.en: A potter wasp landed on the rim of the empty flowerpot.
entries.zh: 一只蜾蠃落在了空花盆的边缘。

entries.en: Powdery mildew had spread across several leaves of the rosebush.
entries.zh: 白粉病已蔓延到那株玫瑰的几片叶子上。

entries.en: The prairie anemone was partly hidden behind a fallen branch.
entries.zh: 那株美国白头翁有一部分被落下的树枝挡住了。

entries.en: The prairie chicken paused beside the fence before moving out of sight.
entries.zh: 那只草原榛鸡在围栏旁停了一会儿，随后消失在视野中。

entries.en: The workers left the prairie gourd intact while repairing the path.
entries.zh: 工人修路时没有损坏那株臭瓜。

entries.en: The horse trailer had flattened a strip of prairie grass.
entries.zh: 运马的拖车压倒了一带草原禾草。

entries.en: She knelt beside the prairie rocket to take a close-up photograph.
entries.zh: 她跪在那株草原桂竹香旁拍了一张特写。

entries.en: The researchers sealed the prairie soil samples in separate bags.
entries.zh: 研究人员把湿草原土样本分别封装在袋子里。

entries.en: The prairie sunflower stood just beyond the reach of the mower.
entries.zh: 那株具柄向日葵正好长在割草机够不到的地方。

entries.en: A prairie wolf crossed the road behind our parked truck.
entries.zh: 一只郊狼从我们停着的卡车后面穿过了公路。

entries.en: The praying mantis remained motionless while I opened the garden gate.
entries.zh: 我打开花园门时，那只螳螂一动不动。

entries.en: The veterinarian examined the bird's preen gland under a bright lamp.
entries.zh: 兽医在明亮的灯下检查了那只鸟的尾脂腺。

entries.en: The gardener wore thick gloves while moving the prickly ash.
entries.zh: 园丁搬动那株美洲花椒时戴着厚手套。

entries.en: A prickly poppy grew beside the abandoned wheelbarrow.
entries.zh: 一株蓟罂粟长在废弃的独轮车旁。

entries.en: The pride of Barbados blocked our view of the small fountain.
entries.zh: 那株黄蝴蝶挡住了我们看小喷泉的视线。

entries.en: The injured bird had lost a primary feather from its left wing.
entries.zh: 那只受伤的鸟左翼掉了一根初级飞羽。

entries.en: She placed the detached primary quill beside a ruler for the photograph.
entries.zh: 她把那根脱落的初级飞羽放在尺子旁拍照。

entries.en: The metallurgist examined the primary solid solution in the polished alloy sample.
entries.zh: 冶金学家检查了抛光合金样品中的原固溶体。

entries.en: Several plants from the primrose family survived the accidental damage to the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 温室意外受损后，几株报春花科植物存活了下来。

entries.en: The primrose jasmine had grown over the low wall behind the shed.
entries.zh: 棚屋后的云南黄素馨已长过了矮墙。

entries.en: The proboscis monkey climbed out of view as the boat passed.
entries.zh: 船驶过时，那只长鼻猴爬出了我们的视野。

entries.en: The proboscis worm stretched across the bottom of the shallow observation dish.
entries.zh: 那只纽形动物伸展身体，横在浅观察皿的底部。

entries.en: We stopped the car when a pronghorn antelope approached the roadside.
entries.zh: 一只叉角羚走近路边时，我们停下了车。

entries.en: The child stepped over a prop root without touching it.
entries.zh: 孩子跨过了一条支柱根，没有碰到它。

entries.en: The mason set a block of pudding stone beside the entrance steps.
entries.zh: 石匠把一块圆砾岩安放在入口台阶旁。

entries.en: The pumpkin ash cast a long shadow over the parked bicycles.
entries.zh: 那棵绒毛白蜡树的长影映在停放的自行车上。

entries.en: The buyer requested pure gold rather than a cheaper alloy.
entries.zh: 买家要求用纯金，而不是较便宜的合金。

entries.en: The laboratory kept samples of purple bacteria in numbered culture tubes.
entries.zh: 实验室把紫色细菌样本保存在编号的培养管中。

entries.en: The purple beech hid most of the house from the road.
entries.zh: 从公路上看，那棵紫叶山毛榉遮住了房子的大半部分。

entries.en: A purple emperor landed on the handle of the abandoned spade.
entries.zh: 一只紫蛱蝶落在了那把闲置铁锹的柄上。

entries.en: The purple gallinule stepped behind a rock as we raised our binoculars.
entries.zh: 我们举起双筒望远镜时，那只紫青水鸡走到了石头后面。

entries.en: The gardener removed the broken stake beside the purple loosestrife.
entries.zh: 园丁拔掉了千屈菜旁那根断裂的支桩。

entries.en: The purple martin disappeared behind the roof before I could take a photograph.
entries.zh: 我还没来得及拍照，那只北美洲紫燕就消失在屋顶后面了。

entries.en: The children tied a ribbon around the purple osier near the gate.
entries.zh: 孩子们在门边那株紫柳上系了一条丝带。

entries.en: A fallen leaf partly covered the purple trillium beside the path.
entries.zh: 一片落叶遮住了小路旁那株直立延龄草的一部分。

entries.en: The purple willow was reflected in the rainwater beside the empty pot.
entries.zh: 那株紫柳倒映在空花盆旁的积水里。

entries.en: She photographed the pussy willow from the upstairs balcony.
entries.zh: 她从楼上的阳台拍下了那株褪色柳。

entries.en: The pygmy chimpanzee picked up the cloth left by the keeper.
entries.zh: 那只矮小黑猩猩捡起了饲养员留下的布。

entries.en: Quack grass had grown through the cracks in the abandoned tennis court.
entries.zh: 偃麦草从废弃网球场的裂缝里长了出来。

entries.meaningZh: 参加四分之一英里竞赛的赛马
entries.en: The quarter horse stumbled during the quarter-mile race but quickly recovered.
entries.zh: 那匹赛马在四分之一英里的比赛中绊了一下，但很快恢复了平衡。

entries.en: The technician checked the quartz glass for damage before assembling the instrument.
entries.zh: 组装仪器前，技术员检查了石英玻璃是否受损。

entries.en: The beekeeper located the queen bee before lifting the next frame.
entries.zh: 养蜂人在提起下一个巢框前找到了蜂王。

entries.en: The machinist tested a strip of quenched steel from the new batch.
entries.zh: 机械加工师测试了新批次中的一条淬火钢。

entries.en: The groom brushed the race horse before leading it into the trailer.
entries.zh: 马夫先给赛马刷了毛，再把它牵进拖车。

entries.en: A race runner slipped between two stones beside my boot.
entries.zh: 一只鞭尾蜥从我靴子旁的两块石头之间溜走了。

entries.en: The inspector sealed the filter containing radioactive dust inside a protective container.
entries.zh: 检查员把含有放射性尘埃的过滤器密封在防护容器内。

entries.en: The raffia palm filled the largest corner of the glasshouse.
entries.zh: 那株酒椰属植物占满了温室最大的角落。

entries.en: The rag gourd had climbed over the frame above the doorway.
entries.zh: 那株丝瓜已经爬过了门口上方的架子。

entries.en: The printer saved the rag paper for the limited edition.
entries.zh: 印刷商把碎布优质纸留给了限量版印刷品。

entries.en: A broken branch hung from the rain tree above the empty bench.
entries.zh: 空长凳上方那棵雨树垂着一根折断的树枝。

entries.en: The rainbow perch turned away as the camera approached the glass.
entries.zh: 相机靠近玻璃时，那条虹鲈转身游开了。

entries.en: The rainbow shower shaded the small table beside the garden wall.
entries.zh: 那株虹光花给园墙旁的小桌子遮住了阳光。

entries.en: A raisin moth flew out when the shopkeeper opened the storage cupboard.
entries.zh: 店主打开储物柜时，一只葡萄干斑螟飞了出来。

entries.en: The cook poured a little rape oil into the hot pan.
entries.zh: 厨师往热锅里倒了一点菜油。

entries.en: The rescued raptorial bird watched the keeper from its perch.
entries.zh: 那只获救的猛禽在栖木上注视着饲养员。

entries.en: The chemist isolated a rare earth from the mixed sample.
entries.zh: 化学家从混合样本中分离出了一种稀土元素。

entries.en: The rat kangaroo paused beside the keeper's empty feeding bowl.
entries.zh: 那只鼠袋鼠在饲养员的空食盆旁停了下来。

entries.en: The rat snake slid beneath the fallen branch without disturbing the leaves.
entries.zh: 那条鼠蛇从落下的树枝底下滑过，没有扰动树叶。

entries.en: The botanist drew the rattlesnake root before collecting a leaf sample.
entries.zh: 植物学家先画下了那株福王草属植物，再采集叶片样本。

entries.en: The gardener protected the rattlesnake weed with a small wire frame.
entries.zh: 园丁用一个小铁丝架护住了那株山柳菊。

entries.en: She mixed raw umber with white to soften the shadow in her painting.
entries.zh: 她把生褐与白色颜料混合，使画中的阴影更柔和。

entries.en: The carpenter sanded the raw wood before applying the first coat.
entries.zh: 木匠给原木打磨后，才涂上第一层涂料。

entries.en: The student detached a ray floret with a pair of fine tweezers.
entries.zh: 学生用一把细镊子取下了一朵舌状花。

entries.en: The cook arranged the razor clam beside the other shellfish on the platter.
entries.zh: 厨师把那只蛏子与其他贝类一起摆在了大盘上。

entries.en: The cook rinsed the razor fish before adding them to the pot.
entries.zh: 厨师把竹蛏洗净后，再放进锅里。

entries.en: The razor-billed auk turned its head toward the approaching boat.
entries.zh: 那只刀嘴海雀把头转向了靠近的船。

entries.en: The red alder beside the driveway had lost a large branch.
entries.zh: 车道旁那棵红桤木掉了一根大枝。

entries.en: The artist painted the red beech without including the fence behind it.
entries.zh: 画家画下了那棵红假山毛榉，没有画它后面的围栏。

entries.en: The plumber replaced the cracked fitting with one made of red brass.
entries.zh: 水管工用一个红黄铜接头换下了开裂的接头。

entries.en: The red campion grew beside the discarded wooden crate.
entries.zh: 那株朝颜剪秋罗长在被丢弃的木箱旁。

entries.en: The potter pressed the red clay into a shallow wooden mold.
entries.zh: 陶工把红黏土压进了一个浅木模里。

entries.en: A strip of red clover remained beside the freshly mown lawn.
entries.zh: 刚修剪过的草坪旁还留着一带红三叶草。

entries.en: The jeweler threaded the polished red coral onto a fine gold chain.
entries.zh: 珠宝匠把抛光的红珊瑚穿在了一条细金链上。

entries.en: The red dogwood stood between two empty flowerbeds.
entries.zh: 那株欧洲红瑞木长在两块空花坛之间。

entries.en: The red drum slipped from the net before the fisherman could lift it.
entries.zh: 渔夫还没来得及提网，那条似石首鱼就滑了出去。

entries.en: The old red elm shaded the bench outside the station.
entries.zh: 那棵老红榆给车站外的长凳遮住了阳光。

entries.en: A red fox crossed the empty playground just after dawn.
entries.zh: 黎明刚过，一只赤狐穿过了空荡荡的操场。

entries.en: The red grouse stepped out of sight as we approached the bend.
entries.zh: 我们走近转弯处时，那只赤松鸡走出了视野。

entries.en: The surveyor marked the red lauan with a loose strip of cloth.
entries.zh: 测量员在那棵菲律宾柳桉上松松地系了一条布作标记。

entries.en: A broken swing hung from the red maple behind the house.
entries.zh: 屋后那棵红花槭上挂着一个坏秋千。

entries.en: The new fence curves around the red mulberry instead of crossing its roots.
entries.zh: 新围栏绕着那棵红果桑弯过去，没有横穿它的根部。

entries.en: The fishmonger wrapped the red mullet in clean paper.
entries.zh: 鱼贩用干净的纸包好了那条羊鱼。

entries.en: The carpenter cut the red oak into narrow strips for the cabinet.
entries.zh: 木匠把红橡木切成窄条，用来做柜子。

entries.en: The red osier was partly hidden by the builder's temporary screen.
entries.zh: 施工人员的临时挡板遮住了那株紫柳的一部分。

entries.en: The red pine stood behind the last house on the lane.
entries.zh: 那棵赤松立在小巷最后一栋房子后面。

entries.en: The gardener tied the red raspberry to a new support.
entries.zh: 园丁把那株覆盆子绑在了新支架上。

entries.en: The cabinetmaker set aside the red sanders for the carved panel.
entries.zh: 家具木匠把红木留作雕花板使用。

entries.en: The red siskin perched on the far end of the wooden bar.
entries.zh: 那只黑头红金翅停在木杆的另一端。

entries.en: A red spider moved across the leaf beneath the magnifying glass.
entries.zh: 放大镜下，一只红蜘蛛在叶片上爬过。

entries.en: The red spruce beside the gate was visible from every bedroom.
entries.zh: 从每间卧室都能看见门边那棵红果云杉。

entries.en: The red squirrel jumped from the railing onto our parked bicycle.
entries.zh: 那只红松鼠从栏杆跳到了我们停着的自行车上。

entries.en: The gardener left a wide space around the young red willow.
entries.zh: 园丁在那株幼小的平滑柳周围留出了一大片空地。

entries.en: The red-hot poker near the gate was bent by a fallen branch.
entries.zh: 门边那株剑叶兰被落下的树枝压弯了。

entries.meaningZh: 红铅油灰〔旧式密封材料〕
entries.en: The restorer found red-lead putty around a joint in the old pipe.
entries.zh: 修复师在旧管道的一个接缝周围发现了红铅油灰。

entries.en: A red-winged blackbird landed on the gate after the tractor passed.
entries.zh: 拖拉机驶过后，一只美洲红翼鸫落在了大门上。

entries.en: The redbird flower had outgrown its place on the narrow shelf.
entries.zh: 那株红雀仙人掌长大了，窄架子上原来的位置已放不下它。

entries.en: The redfin pickerel darted away when the camera touched the water.
entries.zh: 相机碰到水时，那条美洲狗鱼迅速游开了。

entries.en: The redheaded woodpecker moved behind the trunk before I could focus.
entries.zh: 我还没对好焦，那只红头啄木鸟就移到了树干后面。

entries.en: We watched the reed bunting through a gap in the wooden screen.
entries.zh: 我们透过木挡板的一道缝观察那只芦鹀。

entries.en: The workers cleared a narrow path through the reed canary grass.
entries.zh: 工人们在草芦间清出了一条窄路。

entries.en: The reed mace brushed against the side of our small boat.
entries.zh: 香蒲擦过了我们小船的船舷。

entries.en: She dried the regur soil sample before weighing it.
entries.zh: 她把黑棉土样本干燥后才称重。

entries.en: The botanist photographed the reindeer lichen beside a small measuring scale.
entries.zh: 植物学家在一把小标尺旁拍摄了石蕊。

entries.en: The requiem shark swam beyond the diver's light.
entries.zh: 那条真鲨科鱼游出了潜水员灯光照到的范围。

entries.en: The geologist collected residual clay from the newly exposed slope.
entries.zh: 地质学家从新裸露的坡面采集了残留黏土。

entries.en: The cleaner scrubbed away the residual soil around the sink.
entries.zh: 清洁工擦掉了水槽周围的残留污垢。

entries.en: The resurrection plant stood in a shallow tray on the workbench.
entries.zh: 那株还魂植物放在工作台上的一个浅托盘里。

entries.en: The rheumatism weed was bent beneath a piece of fallen fencing.
entries.zh: 那株印度麻被倒下的一段围栏压弯了。

entries.en: A rice rat slipped behind the empty bucket as I approached.
entries.zh: 我走近时，一只稻鼠溜到了空桶后面。

entries.en: The inspector found a rice weevil inside the sealed sample bag.
entries.zh: 检查员在密封样品袋里发现了一只米象。

entries.en: The roofer replaced the cracked ridge tile before the rain began.
entries.zh: 下雨前，屋顶工换掉了那块开裂的屋脊瓦。

entries.en: The guide chose a calm riding horse for the nervous beginner.
entries.zh: 向导给那名紧张的初学者挑了一匹温顺的骑乘马。

entries.en: A right whale appeared briefly beyond the bow of the research vessel.
entries.zh: 一头露脊鲸在科考船船头前方短暂出现。

entries.en: The ring ouzel landed on the wall above our parked bicycles.
entries.zh: 那只环颈鸫落在我们停放自行车处上方的墙头。

entries.en: The ring snake slid into the gap beneath the wooden gate.
entries.zh: 那条游蛇滑进了木门下面的缝隙。

entries.en: A ring-necked pheasant crossed the driveway in front of the gardener.
entries.zh: 一只环颈雉从园丁前方穿过了车道。

entries.en: We watched the ringed snake without moving the branch that sheltered it.
entries.zh: 我们看着那条游蛇，没有挪动给它遮蔽的树枝。

entries.en: The gardener tied the ringworm bush to a stronger wooden stake.
entries.zh: 园丁把那株金钱癣灌木绑在了一根更结实的木桩上。

entries.en: The ringworm cassia stood beside a cracked clay pot.
entries.zh: 那株金钱癣灌木长在一个开裂的陶盆旁。

entries.en: The river horse entered the water while the visitors watched from the bridge.
entries.zh: 游客们在桥上看着那头河马走进水里。

entries.en: The truck tipped a load of road metal beside the damaged lane.
entries.zh: 卡车在受损的小路旁卸下了一车铺路石。

entries.en: The robber fly settled on a sunlit fence post.
entries.zh: 那只食虫虻停在了一根被阳光照着的围栏柱上。

entries.en: The photographer placed a ruler beside the rock barnacle for scale.
entries.zh: 摄影师在那只藤壶旁放了一把尺子，作为比例参照。

entries.en: The rock bass turned beneath the boat and vanished into deeper water.
entries.zh: 那条大耳鲈在船底下转了个方向，消失在更深的水里。

entries.en: The rock beauty moved behind a stone just as the camera flashed.
entries.zh: 相机闪光时，那条三色刺蝶鱼正游到石头后面。

entries.en: The rock crab gripped the edge of the empty shell.
entries.zh: 那只岩黄道蟹抓住了空壳的边缘。

entries.en: The rock cress survived beside the wall after the rest of the bed was cleared.
entries.zh: 花坛其他地方被清空后，墙边的筷子芥仍然活着。

entries.en: A rock dove landed on the station roof above the clock.
entries.zh: 一只原鸽落在车站屋顶上，正好在时钟上方。

entries.en: The old rock elm stood beside a disused railway platform.
entries.zh: 那棵老木栓榆立在一个废弃的铁路站台旁。

entries.en: The rock hyrax disappeared behind the keeper's shed.
entries.zh: 那只蹄兔消失在饲养员的棚屋后面。

entries.en: We placed the picnic basket in the shade of the rock maple.
entries.zh: 我们把野餐篮放在了那棵糖槭的树荫下。

entries.en: The rock pigeon pecked at a crumb beside the empty bench.
entries.zh: 那只野鸽啄着空长凳旁的一小块碎屑。

entries.en: The gardener lifted the rock plant before repairing the cracked stone trough.
entries.zh: 园丁先移出了那株岩生植物，再修理开裂的石槽。

entries.en: The rock purslane had spread beyond the edge of its shallow pot.
entries.zh: 那株岩马齿苋已长出了浅花盆的边缘。

entries.en: The rock rabbit watched us from behind a low stone wall.
entries.zh: 那只蹄兔从一道矮石墙后面望着我们。

entries.en: The rocket larkspur in her sketch was taller than the surrounding plants.
entries.zh: 她的素描中，那株飞燕草比周围的植物都高。

entries.en: She rinsed the rocket salad and left it to drain in a colander.
entries.zh: 她洗净芝麻菜，把它放在漏勺里沥水。

entries.en: The rangers closed the road after a rogue elephant charged at a truck.
entries.zh: 一头离群的凶猛野象冲向卡车后，护林员封闭了公路。

entries.en: A roof rat slipped behind the boxes before the inspector switched on his torch.
entries.zh: 检查员还没打开手电筒，一只屋顶鼠就钻到了箱子后面。

entries.en: The builders covered the roofing material before the overnight storm.
entries.zh: 工人们在夜间风暴来临前盖好了屋面材料。

entries.en: A gust of wind lifted the loose corner of the roofing paper.
entries.zh: 一阵风掀起了屋顶油纸未固定好的一角。

entries.en: The roofing tile broke when the ladder fell against it.
entries.zh: 梯子倒下来砸到那块屋面瓦，把它砸碎了。

entries.en: The root climber had covered half the wall behind the greenhouse.
entries.zh: 那株根攀缘植物已覆盖了温室后面的一半墙面。

entries.en: The farmer harvested the root crop before the field became waterlogged.
entries.zh: 田地积水前，农民收获了块根农作物。

entries.en: The rose acacia shaded a small bench near the gate.
entries.zh: 那株毛洋槐给门边的一张小长凳遮住了阳光。

entries.en: The rose bay stood in a large pot beside the locked entrance.
entries.zh: 那株夹竹桃种在上锁的入口旁的一个大花盆里。

entries.en: A rose beetle landed on the gardener's sleeve and stayed there.
entries.zh: 一只玫瑰金龟子落在园丁的袖子上，停着没走。

entries.en: The student sketched the rose chafer through the side of the observation box.
entries.zh: 学生隔着观察箱的侧壁画下了那只蔷薇刺金龟。

entries.en: The rose geranium on her desk had outgrown its small pot.
entries.zh: 她桌上的香叶天竺葵长大了，小花盆已经装不下。

entries.en: A single rose hip lay beside the fallen leaves on the path.
entries.zh: 一颗野玫瑰果落在小路的落叶旁。
